'''Gianfranco''' is a male student NPC who caught his classmate, '''Ebersole''', trying to eat evidence of his crime.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;Who the **** buried this "[["Crack & Bolt" Fish Jar|Crack & Bolt]]" fish jar in Plot 2?! Get it out of here!
:;Let me be crystal clear: NO FISH JARS IN THE ACADEMY!

:;'''Gianfranco''' Ugh... w-what are you eating?!
:;'''Ebersole''' Burp! Shut up!
:;'''Ebersole''' Just get over here and help me finish it! We're running out of time!

==Dialogue==
:'''Gianfranco:''' Ugh... w-what are you eating?!
:'''Gianfranco:''' Wait, this fish jar... so you're the one who buried this disgusting thing in Plot 2! Urgh...
:'''Ebersole:''' Shut up! Just get over here and help me finish it! We're running out of time!
:'''Gianfranco:''' Wha—? You seriously need to get your head checked!
:'''Ebersole:''' Burp... So here are your options: either you eat it and fake a stomach bug for sick leave, or you go do that taste test for experimental samples. Your call.
:'''Gianfranco:''' You...! Ugh, fine! Save some for me!
{{Dialogue End}}
